what_happened: In stop-and-go traffic with a LEFT command, the ego crept forward at about 1 m/s while edging left across the lane line toward the lane of stopped car 24. It closed the gap and its front ran into 24's rear corner, about 3.3 m off the recorded path.

On a multi-lane highway, the ego slowed from 7.9 to 4.5 m/s while its plan (orange) pulled it left, even though the route command was STRAIGHT and then RIGHT. Its front corner hit actor 41 (the white pickup), which was passing in the lane to the left.

On a multi-lane highway the ego slowed from 7.9 to 4.5 m/s and drifted left toward the next lane, even though the route command was STRAIGHT and then RIGHT and the human drove straight. Its front corner hit the white pickup (actor 41) as it came up alongside on the left.

On a multi-lane highway, the ego slowed from 7.9 to 4.4 m/s while its plan drifted left, even though the route command was STRAIGHT and then RIGHT. Its front hit actor 41, a white SUV that was overtaking in the adjacent left lane; at impact the ego's box is across the lane line under 41's rear.

On a multi-lane highway the command was STRAIGHT, then RIGHT. Instead of following it, the ego drifted left out of its lane toward the left lane line while slowing from 7.9 to 4.3 m/s. Actor 41 was passing on the left, and the ego's front struck it as the ego moved into that lane, about 1.7 m off the recorded path, which stayed straight and bore right.

On a clear multi-lane highway with no lead vehicle (gap null after handoff), the policy slowed for no reason, from 10.1 to 6.9 m/s, falling about 20 m behind where the human drove. Actor 28, which replays the logged drive and cannot react, came up from behind and overlapped the ego's rear at 7.1 s. That overlap was scored as an at-fault front collision, even though it is really a rear-end set off by the ego's phantom braking.

On an open highway with no lead vehicle, the ego stayed on the recorded path (0.4 m off) but slowed from about 10 to 6.9 m/s for no visible reason, ending up about 20 m behind where the human was. Replayed actor 23 came up from behind on the right, cut into the ego's lane and overlapped the ego's front-right corner. This was logged as a front collision, and the run also shows rear contact.

On a clear highway with no lead vehicle within 50 m, the ego slowed for no apparent reason from 10.1 to 6.8 m/s after handoff, ending up about 20 m behind where the human drove. Actor 23, which replays the recorded drive and doesn't react to the ego, came up from behind and slightly to the right and drove into the slowed ego at 7.1 s. The overlap was recorded as a front collision, but the run is also flagged rear_ended.

On an open multi-lane highway with no close lead (gap about 57 m), the ego slowed steadily for no clear reason, from 10.1 to 6.8 m/s after handoff, and fell about 20 m behind the recorded drive. At 7.1 s, replayed actor 18 coming up from behind overlaps the ego's rear-right corner; this is logged as a front collision but looks like the follower running into the slowed ego.

Right after handoff on a straight highway, replayed actor 18 overlapped the ego's rear (a rear contact at 5.6s) and drove through it. The ego then braked hard, from 23.7 to 6.2 m/s, and ended up about 10 m behind where the recorded car was; drifting slightly left (1.2 m off the recorded path), its front-left corner hit actor 1, which was passing in the left lane at 7.6s.

At handoff the ego was going 23.7 m/s only 1.3 m behind actor 18, with boxes touching at 5.6 s. It then braked hard to 5.8 m/s even though the lane ahead had cleared to about 50 m, and drifted left off its planned path into the next lane, where its front-left corner hit actor 1 as actor 1 passed the slowing ego at 7.6 s.

The policy took over on the highway already about 1 m behind actor 18. It braked hard (23.7 to 6.3 m/s) even after 18 pulled away, and actor 1 hit the ego's rear around 5.6 s. With the ego slow and its nose drifting left toward the adjacent lane, its front-left then struck actor 1 as actor 1 came alongside at 7.6 s.

The policy took over at 23.7 m/s only 1.3 m behind lead car 18. It braked hard, down to 6.5 m/s, and actor 1 rear-ended it at about 5.6 s. Actor 1 then pulled up on the ego's left, and at 7.6 s the ego's planned path hooked left and its front struck actor 1, even though the lane ahead was clear (54 m gap).

The policy took over only 1.3 m behind actor 18. It braked hard from 23.7 to 6.5 m/s while the recorded human kept going, and actor 1 hit its rear at about 5.6 s. Still braking, the ego then drifted about 1.2 m left of its recorded line toward the left lane. At 7.6 s its front-left hit actor 1, which by then was moving into the left lane and was alongside.

The ego got within about 1 m of lead vehicle 18 at 18 m/s and then braked hard, dropping to about 5 m/s on an open highway lane (the gap ahead had grown to 54 m) and drifting slightly left. By 8.6 s it was about 20 m behind where the recorded car was, and vehicle 28, replayed from the recording and coming up from behind on the right, drove into the ego's front-right side, which counted as a front collision.
